subject: Limit for # of Shiny developers for shinyapps.io pro plan?

messages.author: 10479dbbc0929eb2
messages.subject: Limit for # of Shiny developers for shinyapps.io pro plan?
parts:
Hello,
I have been discussing the possibility of opening a shinyapps.io Professional plan with other developers at my research institute. At the current time, I am unsure how many other developers will be interested in having access to the account, but I was unable to find information on the shinyapps.io website regarding the number of Shiny developers that can share an organizational professional account. Are there any such limits?
Thanks,
Andrea

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Limit for # of Shiny developers for shinyapps.io pro plan?
parts:
The limit is 25 members beyond the owner of the account.

I will track work to add that information to the user's guide.
